question: The ‘Hornbill Festival’ is a celebration held every year from 1 to 10 December in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 20th edition of the Hornbill Festival began on December 1, 2019.
 
• It is also called the 'Festival of Festivals'.
 
• This day was also the 57th Statehood Day of Nagaland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This festival was celebrated for the promotion of tourism and for the exhibition of the state’s tradition and culture in which the Naga tribe showcased their art.
 
• The festival was celebrated for 10 days straight.
 
• The host of the opening ceremony of the festival was Governor - Ravindra Narayana Ravi and Chief Minister of Nagaland-Neiphiu Rio.
 
• Nagaland Capital-Kohima
 
• Note:
 
 
• ​The current(Feb 2022) Governor of Nagaland is Jagdish Mukhi.
